notes.title: ⚡ No Time to Loot – we are in!
notes.notes: [p]For one week it’s all about looting fast and deciding even faster. From September 22 to 29, Steam is hosting the No Time to Loot Festival – organized by Humban Qube, Sidekick Publishing & Gamersky Games – and we’re jumping in![/p][p]With us, it’s not about rummaging around – it’s about surviving under pressure. No breaks, no breathing room – just the next run, the next choice, the next button press.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Drop by, discover new games, and maybe grab a deal or two along the way.[/p]

notes.title: 👻 My Little Cafe Nightmare DEMO OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[p]We are excited to announce that we are collaborating with SethMadDev to bring you...[/p][p][/p][h2]☕ [b]My Little Cafe Nightmare[/b][/h2][p]Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.[b]
[/b][/p][p]From today onwards, you can play a demo of My Little Cafe Nightmare. Check it out, enjoy the spooky cafe, decorate and satisfy your customer with deadly good coffee. In our demo, you will be able to experience some of the content from our full game. Not all of it, but some of it.[/p][p][/p][h2]💀 [b]Demo Content[/b] 👻[/h2][list][*][p][b]Unlock[/b] 5 out of 10 levels[/p][/*][*][p]30 out of 60 purchasable [b]items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Experiment with 5 different [b]flavors[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decorate[/b] and [b]expand[/b] your [b]Café[/b] by up to 4 rooms[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960880/My_Little_Cafe_Nightmare_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We are also releasing a brand new trailer for the game alongside the demo! Get a better idea of what you can expect to be doing in the demo:[/p][previewyoutube="WCoH5R8Xq0s;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This is the first time Ivy Juice Games goes publishing and we would love to hear your feedback! If you want to talk about the game or chat with us in general - [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]join our Discord[/url]!

Best,
Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: SCHROTT x Games Against Living Miserably
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="buDprkaYtog;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Running from 8–15 September, to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, this event celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape. It’s presented by Curve Games and the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM).[/p][p][/p][p]Every developer and publisher taking part has pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work - so are we![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🔧 Tutorial Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]⚙️ New Tutorial[/b][/h1][h3][b]version deployed 0.6.5[/b][/h3][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][p]You guys complained a lot that our tutorial didn't teach you anything. We thought it would be easy to teach you all the mechanics just by playing the game, but we realize that's a lot to expect while driving at full speed through a gigantic rift! We have overhauled the current tutorial and added text boxes and flashy images to explain everything. We hope this does the job — if not, join our [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord server[/url] and let us know why. We love the feedback you're giving us, and we love implementing your ideas.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, and we've also updated some other things in the game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]major tutorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p]added progress menu to garage and tutorial menu[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]added keyboard navigation for ui tab navigation[/p][/*][*][p]added more new chunks to biome 1[/p][/*][*][p]added new ad banner colors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]increased juice gain slightly[/p][/*][*][p]removed scrap drops from ad sails[/p][/*][*][p]reduced scrap cost increase in the pitstop during a run[/p][/*][*][p]reduced cost of some parts in the pitstop during a run[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted some parts of the map to be more fair[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]fixed slower obstacle mod not working properly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Quality of life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]inventory now shows both cards (of equipped and selected part)[/p][/*][*][p]equipped parts in inventory are properly highlighted on selection[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]looting an empty part-box will now also show a card pop-up[/p][/*][*][p]improved pitstop UI layout[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]changed the color of default part icons in inventories to make them more distinguishable from other parts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Again: If you find any bugs, want to give feedback or have some nice Ideas to make the game even better, feel free to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord[/url] and let us know.[/p][p]Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Our First Ever Gameplay Video is Here!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Our First Ever Gameplay Video is Here![/b][/h2][p]We just recorded our very first gameplay video where we tested our own game as if we were playing it for the very first time. Along the way, we explain the core mechanics, talk about all the features, and show off what makes our roguelite racer unique.[/p][p]Just two days ago, we released a brand-new update - and this video includes a showcase of the fresh features it brings. We also jump into a few runs to really put the game (and ourselves) to the test![/p][p]We’re super excited to share more gameplay with you in the future. This is our first gameplay video ever, so… enjoy - and please don’t be too harsh on us!
[/p][previewyoutube="uwH_hyOl2uA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Best,
Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update | Patch 0.6.5
notes.notes: [h1][b]⚙️ New version deployed 0.6.5[/b][/h1][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We've listened to your feedback and added some new quality-of-life improvements to our game. Highlights include an updated inventory and new skills and upgrades.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]skill upgrades are now communicated more clearly in Skill chunks, the pitstop, and the Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]added new Salt Lake chunks (Biome 1)[/p][/*][*][p]scrap costs are increased with each consecutive pitstop[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]cacti now give Juice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed an issue where parts could be equipped in the background when progressing in the reward menu after a run[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed screenshake stacking[/p][/*][*][p]fixed juice and scrap loot colliding with drive camera[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where the tutorial reward mod would disappear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]adjusted all scrap costs in the pitstop[/p][/*][*][p]reduced Juice gain overall[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]improved inventory UI to make equipped items more visible[/p][/*][*][p]added a Pause Menu pop-up for “Quit Game” or “Give Up Run” confirmation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]improved chunks (level-design)[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted background in main menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]⚠️ Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]closing give up or quit menu with controller will also close pause menu at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]vSync enabled can cause lags[/p][/*][*][p]some graphics settings override each other[/p][/*][*][p]open pause will reset invincibility timer[/p][/*][*][p]no proper widescreen support[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you have any feedback for us, please get in touch – for example, via [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ SCHROTT @ Games Ground Berlin
notes.notes:
[h2]⚙️ Meet us November 14th – 16th at Games Ground Berlin ⚙️[/h2]

Hello SCHROTT community! We’re excited to share some big news: SCHROTT will be featured at Games Ground Berlin, and we’d love for you to come by and say hi! 🎉

📅 Event Details
When? November 14th – 16th
Where? Alte Münze, Berlin Germany

🔗 [url=https://www.gamesground.de/]More about Games Ground Berlin[/url]

Here’s what to expect:

[list]
[*] New Content and Merch: We’ll be showing off some fresh content and you will be able to get cool stickers!
[*] Meet the Devs: Connect with our development team, and dive into the world of SCHROTT with us!
[*] Feedback and Discussion: We value your feedback, and we’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas to keep making SCHROTT better.
[/list]

If you’re in Berlin or nearby, don’t miss out! We’d love to meet you and work together on shaping the future of SCHROTT.

Looking forward to seeing you in Berlin! 💥
